title: Eternality of God
definition: The eternality of God means that God has no beginning, no end, and is not limited by time as creatures are.
summary: God is everlasting, without beginning or end.
christFocus: Jesus Christ shares eternal glory with the Father and is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's eternality means He is not trapped in time. He is before all things, sustains all things, and remains after all things. Time is part of creation; God is the eternal Lord over it.

Because God is eternal, His purposes are not rushed, surprised, or threatened. His promises are not weakened by delay, and His faithfulness does not expire.

The eternal Son entered time in the incarnation without ceasing to be eternal God. In Christ, the everlasting God came near to save temporal people.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Human life is brief, and delay often makes people anxious. The eternality of God matters because it anchors believers in the Lord whose wisdom and faithfulness are not limited by our timetable.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Trust God's timing when you cannot see the full picture. Let His eternal faithfulness steady you in waiting, suffering, aging, and uncertainty.
